symptom: Won't run or power up (dead keypad/console) No operation, no keypad response, no LEDs or display.
failure_mode: Faulty control The electronic control is faulty.
corrective_action: Replace control Replace the faulty electronic control. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Check/replace control.

symptom: Won't run or power up (dead keypad/console) No operation, no keypad response, no LEDs or display.
failure_mode: No power to unit or bad connection No power to the unit or a bad power connection.
failure_mode_name: No power to unit or bad connection

symptom: Will not fill or low water The dishwasher will not fill with water or fills with too little water.
failure_mode: Low water pressure or no water to dishwasher Water pressure is low or no water reaches the dishwasher.
failure_mode_name: Low water pressure or no water to dishwasher
corrective_action: Correct installation as necessary Restore an adequate water supply by correcting the installation. Restore an adequate water supply by correcting the installation as necessary.

symptom: Will not fill or low water The dishwasher will not fill with water or fills with too little water.
failure_mode: Inlet screen on fill valve plugged The inlet screen on the fill valve is plugged.
failure_mode_name: Inlet screen on fill valve plugged

symptom: Wash pump will not pump The wash pump does not pump water during the cycle.
failure_mode: Excessive suds in pump Excessive suds are present in the wash pump.
corrective_action: Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds Repeatedly fill and drain the dishwasher until excessive suds are removed. Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds.
corrective_action_name: Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds

symptom: Wash pump will not pump The wash pump does not pump water during the cycle.
failure_mode: Faulty motor start capacitor The wash pump motor start capacitor is faulty.
corrective_action: Replace the motor start capacitor if open Replace the wash-pump motor start capacitor when it tests open. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Disconnect capacitor leads and confirm capacitance is as labeled on part or check resistance for open circuit across the terminals. Replace if open.
corrective_action_name: Replace the motor start capacitor if open

symptom: Will not drain or excess water left in unit The dishwasher will not drain or excess water remains in the unit.
failure_mode: Diameter of drain hose too small The installed drain hose diameter is too small.
failure_mode_name: Diameter of drain hose too small
corrective_action: Install proper drain hose Install a drain hose with the proper diameter. Check/install proper drain hose.

symptom: Will not drain or excess water left in unit The dishwasher will not drain or excess water remains in the unit.
failure_mode: Drain loop check valve not sealing and waste line plugged The drain loop check valve does not seal while the disposer or waste line is plugged.
failure_mode_name: Drain loop check valve not sealing and waste line plugged
corrective_action: Replace entire drain loop Replace the complete drain loop when the check valve leaks back. If water flows into dishwasher, replace entire drain loop.

symptom: Will not drain or excess water left in unit The dishwasher will not drain or excess water remains in the unit.
failure_mode: Drain pump impeller fractured The drain pump impeller is fractured or stripped.
corrective_action: Replace the drain pump if the impeller is stripped Replace the drain pump when its impeller is stripped. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Remove drain pump and check impeller by pulling and rotating. If stripped - replace.
corrective_action_name: Replace the drain pump if the impeller is stripped

symptom: Will not drain or excess water left in unit The dishwasher will not drain or excess water remains in the unit.
failure_mode: Obstructed drain hose or path The drain hose or drain path is obstructed.

symptom: Detergent not dispensing The detergent dispenser does not release detergent during the cycle.
failure_mode: Mechanical binding of dispenser lid The dispenser lid is mechanically binding.
corrective_action: Replace the dispenser Replace the mechanically binding dispenser. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Check/replace dispenser.
